from datetime import datetime

token = apis.spotify.login(username='jes.mill@gmail.com', password=[x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='spotify'][0])['access_token']

# song_ids set should exist from previous executions; if not, raise
print('song_ids count', len(song_ids))

newest = None
newest_dt = None
newest_song = None

# iterate through all unique song ids
for idx, sid in enumerate(sorted(song_ids)):
    s = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    rd = s.get('release_date')
    if not rd:
        continue
    # parse ISO
    try:
        dt = datetime.fromisoformat(rd.replace('Z','+00:00'))
    except Exception:
        # fallback: try date only
        dt = datetime.fromisoformat(rd.split('T')[0])
    if newest_dt is None or dt > newest_dt:
        newest_dt = dt
        newest = (sid, s.get('title'), rd)
        newest_song = s
    if idx % 20 == 0:
        print('progress', idx, 'sid', sid, 'current newest', newest)

print('final newest', newest)
print('final newest title', newest_song.get('title') if newest_song else None)
